name: live-platform
pitch: Share a screen, a voice and a camera,
sub: A browser call with its own Go media server. No account, nothing to install.
heroLabel: live-platform: share a screen, a voice and a camera, from a link. A browser call with its own Go media server. No account, nothing to install.

diagrams.label: How a call flows. The browser opens the page and API over HTTPS, signalling over a WebSocket and media over UDP with DTLS-SRTP. One Go process runs the page and API, the signalling, a presence hub with one actor per room, and a Pion SFU that forwards each participant's media to the others.
